question.text: As per the workbook, anonymous donations received by a charitable NPO or institution (other than a wholly religious trust) are taxed at:

answer.text: A flat rate of 30% (plus applicable surcharge and cess)
A flat rate of 10% (plus applicable surcharge and cess)
A flat rate of 20% (plus applicable surcharge and cess)
A flat rate of 40% on the full anonymous donation (plus applicable surcharge and cess)

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook supports taxation of anonymous donations received by a charitable NPO or institution at a flat rate of 30%. This treatment is part of the income-tax framework the SIA must keep in view when reviewing donor receipts and tax-status disclosures of an NPO. The Trap: 10% and 20% are rates associated with other heads of income, not anonymous donations. 40% overstates the rate. Note: Any specific monetary threshold or exemption mechanic on top of the 30% rate is a matter of the underlying Income-tax provisions and should be verified from an official Income-tax source rather than inferred from the workbook text.
